title: Revocation of interlocutory orders.
bodyText: Any interlocutory order under this chapter, made upon the court's own motion, may be revoked, modified, or extended by it upon appropriate notice to the parties.
bodyHtml: [§657D-53]  Revocation of interlocutory orders.  Any interlocutory order under this chapter, made upon the court's own motion, may be revoked, modified, or extended by it upon appropriate notice to the parties. [L 1994, c 257, pt of §2]
